title: Umthwalo Wesipho Esingavunywanga
intro: Ekuqaleni kwembali yoluntu, xa umhlaba wawusemncinci kwaye ihlabathi libambe umoya walo wokuqala, umphefumlo wema phambi koMdali nomnikelo othobekileyo. Loo mnikelo walinganiswa ngokwemilinganiselo yokwamkelwa nguThixo - waza wafunyanwa uswele. Okwalandela kwakungengombali woxolelo, kodwa yintliziyo ezaliswe ngumona, eyakhokelela kwisenzo esingaguqukiyo esasiza kuhlala sivakala. Eli libali lomntu ogama lakhe lafana nokungekho sikweni kokuqala okukhulu okwenziwayo.
clues: Ndazalwa ndingomnye wabantwana bokuqala ukuzalwa, ndazalwa ngumzali olazi kakuhle ibali lakhe.
Ndakha ndanikela idini ku-Allah, kodwa alizange lamkelwe kum — nangona umnikelo womntakwethu wam wamkelwe ngenceba.
Umona nomsindo zaqala ukuvela entliziyweni yam, ndaza ndasongela ngokuphelisa ubomi bezalamane zam.
Umntakwethu wandilumkisa ukuba ndoyike u-Allah, kodwa ikratshi lam alizange lindivumele ndiphulaphule.
Ngethuba lobuthathaka obukhulu, ndenze isenzo esingenakuchazwa kumntakwethu.
Emva koko, andizange ndikwazi nokufihla into endandiyenzile — de kwathunyelwa isidalwa somhlaba ukuba sifundise mna.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Ukunikela ngedini elaliwayo, nto leyo eyakhokelela ekubulaweni kokuqala
Ukwakha inqaba ephakamileyo ukuze ifikelele emazulwini
Ukuphoswa emlilweni ovuthayo ngenxa yokholo lomntu
Ukuginywa yintlanzi enkulu ngenxa yokubaleka umsebenzi wakho
trial.answer: Ukunikela ngedini elaliwayo, nto leyo eyakhokelela ekubulaweni kokuqala

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Waba ngumntu ozisolayo, othwaliswe uxanduva lolwaphulo-mthetho lokuqala olwenziwayo
Waxolelwa nguAllah waza wanikwa iParadesi engunaphakade
Wasindiswa yinceba kaThixo emva kokubiza ebumnyameni obukhulu
Wanikwa ubukhosi phezu kweejin, umoya, nolwandle
outcome.answer: Waba ngumntu ozisolayo, othwaliswe uxanduva lolwaphulo-mthetho lokuqala olwenziwayo

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
